features.statement: Body type uses the system-UI font stack only, with no web fonts loaded.
Body text is comfortably sized (about 17px) with generous line height around 1.65.
Headings are bold (700) with a large h1 near 51px and an h2 near 34px.
Small uppercase, letter-spaced gray labels head groups of links.
Palette is navy and blue with a single orange accent on white and pale gray-blue surfaces.
Body text is dark slate rather than pure black.
Orange is reserved for primary purchase or download calls to action.
Links and secondary actions use a consistent mid blue; the dark footer uses pale blue text.
The hero has a white headline on a dark navy-to-blue gradient, the page's only gradient.
Sections alternate between white and light gray-blue background bands.
Content sits in a centered container of about 1080px on a wide page.
The hero is a two-column split with text and CTAs on one side and a product image on the other.
Header pairs a text wordmark without a logo image on the left with dropdown nav items on the right.
Hero CTAs pair a solid filled primary button with an outlined ghost button.
Secondary buttons are outlined in blue on a white fill.
Buttons and cards have small corner radii; most elements are square and there are no pills.
Products appear as three equal-width bordered cards in a row.
Pricing shows the old price struck through beside a larger new price, with an underlined upgrade-price link.
A wide gray banner cross-promotes a related product line with a button.
Inline links within paragraphs are underlined.
Link lists are plain text in the link color, with no icons or bullets.
Product imagery is packaging box-shot artwork rather than interface screenshots, sometimes enlarged beyond natural size.
Featured images get rounded corners and a soft drop shadow.
Purchase configurator is a narrow centered form card with labeled native select dropdowns.
Footer is a multi-column dark link directory with a divider, a social links row and a legal line.
Social links are text-only with no icons, and no SVG icons are used.
Legal line separates items with '//' characters.
Copy is plain and promotional, using em dashes and occasional exclamation marks but no emoji.
The page is link-dense, with many anchors relative to its word count.
Heading hierarchy is irregular, skipping levels and mixing h3 taglines with larger h2s.
Page uses a single h1 plus landmark elements (header, nav, main, section, footer).
All images have alt text and a few ARIA attributes are used.
Markup uses a small custom class vocabulary rather than utility classes, with inline styles and few scripts.
Motion is minimal, with simple transitions but no animations or transforms.
